  - `spring.security.oauth2.resourceserver.jwt.issuer-uri=http://localhost/dummy-keycloak`

What to expect:
- Local/CI tests should now start without trying to contact Keycloak.
- Production remains unchanged (mock disabled unless explicitly set).

Next steps:
- Rerun your CI/build (no extra flags needed) to confirm tests pass in the server environment.
